## What's new

- **Downloads made by the page.** Files a site makes inside its page (Telegram Web's videos, music and documents come from its service worker) used to stay with the browser. Now the extension fetches them inside the page and hands them to NDM piece by piece, so they arrive whole and show in NDM's list like any other download.
- **YouTube and other video sites** through [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp): YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Reddit, SoundCloud, Bilibili and more. Put yt-dlp next to NDM or on your PATH, then paste the page's address or right-click the page → **Download this video with New Download Manager**. With ffmpeg installed, the best video and audio are joined into one MP4. The file is named after the video and goes to the Video category.
- **Checksum.** File Properties → **Checksum...** works out a file's SHA-256, SHA-1 and MD5 and checks it against a checksum you paste.
- **Filter box** above the download list: type to show only the downloads with that text in their name, address or description.
- **Speed Limiter hours.** Downloads → Speed Limiter can limit the speed only between two times of day (for example 08:00 to 23:00).
- **Retries wait longer each time.** A failed download in a queue is tried again after 15 seconds, then 30 seconds, 1 minute and so on, up to 10 minutes, instead of right away.

Reload the extension in your browser (its extensions page → reload, or load the exported folder again) to get the page downloads and the video menu item.
